assign.title: A page watcher per taken pool worktree
assign.outcome: Landed 79a368328 (merged into michael/dev). Servex/WorktreeWatch.js, started by Pool when a worktree is taken, checks changed pages at 400/1200/1920/3440 and sends the holder one line (page, width, measurement, shot path) per page per 10 min, plus a clear log line. Proof on qf-7: a syntax error in page.js reached the owner in 11.8 s, an element pushed off-screen at 400 in 15.4 s; clear lines 15.4 s and 15.3 s after the fix (proof-run.txt). Servex was NOT restarted: the mastermind restarts it after this merge to start the watchers.
